subject.title: [Feature]: Sessions page polish: dot + label status, Runtime column into the row drawer

question: Should the Sessions page adopt the linked PR's dot-plus-label status treatment and move agent runtime out of the roster into the drawer?
rationale: This is visible Control UI scan-density polish on a protected maintainer-labeled issue; current main has not implemented it, and an open closing PR needs maintainer product acceptance before the issue can resolve.

options.title: Review and land the linked UI polish
options.body: Accept the focused roster/drawer direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102664 after normal PR review and proof checks.

options.title: Keep the current roster
options.body: Decide that the existing pill status and Runtime column should remain, then close this issue and the linked PR as not planned.

options.title: Narrow the visual change
options.body: Ask for only one half of the proposal, such as status restyling without moving Runtime, if maintainers want a smaller adjustment.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked UI polish
recommendation.body: Accept the focused roster/drawer direction in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102664 after normal PR review and proof checks.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the recent merged Sessions page UI direction and authored the linked implementation candidate.
